text:
2. 4. 6

Abhinandanasuttaṃ

259. Sāvatthiyaṃ-

Yo bhikkhave, paṭhavīdhātuṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati. Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmā vadāmi. Yo āpodhātuṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati. Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi. Yo tejodhātuṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati. Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi. Yo vāyodhātuṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati. Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi. 

 yo ca kho bhikkhave, paṭhavīdhātuṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati. Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi. Yo āpodhātuṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati, yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi. Yo tejodhātuṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati, yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi. Yo vāyodhātuṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati, yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmī'ti.
